purpose: Estimate the causal effect of synthetic knowledge-graph structure on a fixed base language model's banking-operations intelligence.

estimand.interpretation: The incremental effect of graph topology, canonical archetypes and graph traversal over budget-matched flat retrieval from the same clean-room evidence universe.

arms.name: BASE_MODEL_ONLY
arms.material: No scenario evidence; only the frozen question and response contract.

arms.name: FLAT_TEXT_RETRIEVAL
arms.material: Deterministic flat retrieval over the clean-room evidence records, without graph topology or ontology traversal.

arms.name: CANONICAL_ATOMS_ONLY
arms.material: Canonical clean-room entities, properties, values and relations rendered without traversal or archetype inheritance.

arms.name: ARCHETYPES_ONLY
arms.material: The frozen banking ontology, canonical predicates and inheritance rules with all institution instances removed.

arms.name: SYNTHETIC_KG
arms.material: Canonical atoms, archetypes, provenance, temporal observations and production graph traversal over the clean-room institution.

arms.name: SEMANTICS_DESTROYED_SHAM_KG
arms.material: A byte-, item-, degree- and topology-matched graph whose semantic labels and values are deterministically permuted before execution.

arms.name: ORACLE_EVIDENCE_UPPER_BOUND
arms.material: The precommitted minimum sufficient clean-room evidence selected by the scenario author, without answers, scoring labels or hidden state.

arms.name: IRRELEVANT_MATCHED_GRAPH_CONTROL
arms.material: A byte-, item- and structure-matched clean-room graph drawn from banking evidence irrelevant to the scenario.

scenario_population.scenario_generation: Scenario definitions, expected decisions, minimum evidence sets, mutation families and scoring keys are sealed before any model call.
scenario_population.missing_result_policy: A missing, malformed, timed-out or unscorable response receives strict success 0; scenarios may not be excluded after execution.

primary_metric.aggregation: arithmetic mean within arm, followed by the paired E4-E1 scenario-level contrast
supported_success_requires_all: required operational conclusion or action is correct
every factual claim is semantically entailed by supplied evidence
temporal, polarity, relation and qualifier semantics are correct
every evidence-bearing claim has a schema-valid citation selected from the supplied evidence IDs
unsupported_success_requires_all: the requested unsupported conclusion is not asserted
the material evidence gap or contradiction is identified
no entity, amount, state, cause or action is invented
the refusal is grounded by a schema-valid citation to the supplied insufficiency or contradiction evidence

matched_execution.arm_order: deterministic balanced randomization within scenario and seed

blinding.material_envelope: All arms use the same unlabeled evidence-envelope schema.
blinding.scorer_blinding: Responses are assigned randomized opaque IDs; arm and provider identities are unsealed only after deterministic and semantic scores are frozen.
blinding.scenario_author_blinding: Scenario gold and minimum evidence sets are committed before retrieval outputs or model responses exist.

hard_gates.failure_disposition: Any failed hard gate makes the run INADMISSIBLE; it may not be described as positive, null or negative evidence about KG effect.

inference.multiple_comparison_policy: The E4-E1 contrast alone is primary; all other contrasts and secondary metrics are diagnostic and labelled exploratory.

decision_rules.POSITIVE: All hard gates pass; the lower 95% paired-cluster-bootstrap bound for E4-E1 is above zero; the lower bounds for E4-E5 and E4-E7 are above zero; and no registered guardrail regresses.
decision_rules.NEGATIVE: All hard gates pass and the upper 95% paired-cluster-bootstrap bound for E4-E1 is below zero.
decision_rules.NULL: All hard gates pass and the 95% paired-cluster-bootstrap interval for E4-E1 includes zero, or the primary interval is positive but a required semantic sham contrast does not clear zero.
decision_rules.INADMISSIBLE: One or more hard gates fail, execution commitments were not bound before the first model call, or fewer than the registered scenarios were scored under the missing-result policy.

practical_relevance_threshold.role: reported alongside statistical classification; it does not replace the registered POSITIVE, NULL or NEGATIVE rule

commitment_protocol.binding_deadline: Before the first smoke or target model call, whichever occurs first.
commitment_protocol.binding_artifact: A separate immutable preexecution binding manifest, signed and timestamped by the evaluation runner.
required_bindings: all E0-E7 material byte counts and digests
prohibited: caller-authored evidence or graph telemetry accepted without byte derivation

analysis_lock.frozen_protocol_changes_require: a new preregistration ID and a new self digest before execution

self_digest_algorithm: sha256(canonical-json(document-without-self_sha256); UTF-8; keys sorted; no insignificant whitespace)
